response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM s) AS ana_ratio FROM s

assumptions.assumption: Inner join of Examination to Patient keeps only examinations linked to a patient. AVG ignores NULLs separately for each column. The ratio's denominator is the unweighted mean of the per-sex ANA averages, as the request states, not the pooled ANA mean. Patients with a NULL or blank SEX form their own group, if any exist.
